correctness.rationale: For E_n with e_i^2=e_{i+1}, substitution proves exactly r_i^2=(2r_i+lambda)r_{i+1}, every n>=3 over every field. At lambda!=0, zero is isolated by invertible cyclic Jacobian; on the open all-r_i-nonzero locus t_i=1+lambda/r_i obeys t_{i+1}=t_i^2, so after removing t=1 the coordinate ring splits into t=0 and t^(2^n-1)=1 components. In positive characteristic p, the p-adic multiplicity of M=2^n-1 yields M0+1 geometric points, length M-p^a+2, and exactly M0-1 nonreduced geometric points when p^a>1; field-rational lambda=0 solutions follow by cyclic multiplication. All automorphisms of this perfect evolution algebra are monomial rotations and cyclotomic diagonal factors; only rotations act on diagonal R and Burnside gives g+1 operators and 1+(1/n)*sum_s gcd(g,2^s-1) orbits over Fq. Independent prime-field direct basis equations reproduce (p,n)=(3,4),(5,3),(7,3),(7,6), weight 1, plus rotation counts. The finite counts do not prove scheme local-length statements; their ring derivation does.
